description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated request submissions. This parameter value is generated by the client. The value must be unique among different requests, can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters, and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

description.zh: 修改后的实例名称，可调用[DescribeInstance](~~144594~~)接口获取修改前的实例名称。
description.en: The new name of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~144594~~) operation to query the current instance name.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~144489~~)接口获取。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.
The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the zone ID.
